Hike before 7am or after 6pm and carry extra water.

south-kaibab-ooh-aah.note: Grand Canyon National Park's Key Hiking Messages page, fetched directly today and last updated October 27, 2026, confirms South Kaibab Trail remains open from the South Kaibab Trailhead to Black Bridge, which covers Ooh Aah Point and Cedar Ridge well within the open section (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park). Black Bridge and Silver Bridge, which span the Colorado River, remain closed due to hazardous conditions from flash flooding, so through-hikes to Phantom Ranch or the North Rim are not possible, with no estimated reopening at this time. Potable water is available at the South Kaibab Trailhead tank only. Call the Backcountry Information Center at 928-638-7875 to confirm current status before descending.

bright-angel-indian-garden.note: Grand Canyon National Park's Key Hiking Messages page, fetched directly today and last updated October 27, 2026, confirms Bright Angel Trail remains open from the Bright Angel Trailhead to the River Resthouse, which covers Havasupai Gardens (formerly Indian Garden) well within the open section (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park). Water is off at the Three Mile and Mile and a Half Resthouses and at Havasupai Gardens to conserve water. Beyond River Resthouse, Black Bridge and Silver Bridge remain closed with no estimated reopening, so Phantom Ranch and the river crossing stay inaccessible. Confirm current status with the Backcountry Information Center at 928-638-7875 before descending.

rim-trail.note: Grand Canyon National Park's Key Hiking Messages page, fetched directly today and last updated October 27, 2026, lists no new trail closures beyond the North Rim's seasonal and construction closures, which do not affect the South Rim's Rim Trail, and does not name the Rim Trail among any inner canyon corridor trail closures (Black Bridge, Silver Bridge, and the entirety of North Kaibab Trail) (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park). Use caution near the rim during any lightning.

north-kaibab-coconino.note: The entirety of North Kaibab Trail, from the North Kaibab Trailhead to Phantom Ranch, including Cottonwood Campground, remains closed following significant flash flooding in Bright Angel Canyon on August 29, 2026. The National Park Service's North Rim status page, fetched directly today and last updated November 10, 2026, reconfirms the North Kaibab Trail, Black Bridge, Silver Bridge, and the entire Phantom Ranch facility, including the canteen, Bright Angel Campground, and all overnight lodging, remain closed with no estimated reopening of these closure areas at this time (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park). Bright Angel and Cottonwood Campgrounds remain closed indefinitely.
